findings: Style.owns_font_configuration is set on the AtomImg missing-image fallback and effective_bold, effective_italic, and effective_underline skip the consumer OR. The four CH hold probes (sequence bold, activity bold, class italic, state italic) strict-match at the tip and failed at the base. The six registered image probes under creole-image-fallback-style/checker-independent-ae47 (activity, class, sequence bold, sequence italic, state, title) do the same: base fail, tip match, on the whole SVG.

On ckg6 sequence and class, Java and the tip both draw '(Cannot decode)' as monospace 14 with no font-weight. Base draws those atoms at font-weight 700. Java has five cannot-decode nodes plus a literal . Tip and base have seven cannot-decode nodes. The two extras are the present pix/ckdot.png and the quoted img tag, which Java decodes and Rust still reports as cannot-decode. That decode gap is byte-identical on present_only and is pre-existing. Sequence, activity, state, and class ckg6 images therefore still fail whole-SVG compare after the font fix.

Usecase, component, deployment, mindmap, WBS, gantt, salt, and present_only image probes are byte-identical base versus tip. The font change did not move them. ckg6_img_object and ckg6_img_timing exit 200 with 'Syntax Error? (Assumed diagram type: sequence)' because the probe text is not valid in those families. ckg6_img_salt exits 0 with IllegalStateException '{s' and is an INVALID crash page. Those three are probe problems, not packet regressions.
